name: Six Senses Fiji
positioning: Pool-villa and residence resort on Malolo Island in Fiji's Mamanuca Islands
best_for: Couples wanting a private pool villa by white sand beaches
Families or groups wanting a multi-bedroom residence with its own kitchen and pool
Nature lovers keen to see endangered Fijian crested iguanas

facts.text: Six Senses Fiji is on Malolo Island, the largest of the Mamanuca Islands.
The resort is 16 miles (25 kilometers) from Nadi International Airport.
The resort is surrounded by crystal clear waters and white sand beaches.
Accommodation is pool villas plus residences with three to six bedrooms.
Villas and residences have private pools and westerly outlooks over the bay.
Residences are set in lush vegetation, with beachfront, ocean or marina views.
Surfing, family time and wellness at the resort take their cue from the water.
The spa offers Six Senses holistic treatments.
Guests can join an Iguana Spotting experience.
RaRa serves dinner with different themed menus each evening.
Tovolea serves international fare with a Pacific flair.

highlights.text: The resort is home to Fijian crested iguanas, a critically endangered species, in a protected habitat within the resort.
Accommodation combines traditional style with advanced technologies, private pools and ocean access.
Residences include a huge pool and deck, a fully equipped kitchen and spacious living spaces.
Villas and residences look west over the bay, surrounded by crystal clear waters and white sand beaches.

considerations.text: The resort is on Malolo Island, 16 miles (25 kilometers) from Nadi International Airport.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires a seaplane or boat transfer.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
